subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Medical.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us see the meanings of the given words:
 
 
• **Chemical**: connected with chemistry; involving changes to the structure of a substance. (रसायनशास्‍त्र-विषयक; रासायनिक, किसी पदार्थ की बनावट में होने वाले या हुए परिवर्तन से संबंधित)
 
• **Electrical**: of or about electricity. (विद्युत से संबंधित)
 
• **Geological**: relating to geology, or to the geology of a particular area or place. (भूविज्ञान-विषयक)
 
• **Medical**: connected with medicine and the treatment of illness. (औषधि और रोग के उपचार से संबंधित; डॉक्‍टरी)
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the term **'transplant surgery'** is related to Medical science.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Medical.'
 
• The correct phrase: *Medical** science regularly practises transplant surgery .........*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The meaning of the word** 'transplant'** is to take (living tissue or an organ) and implant it in another part of the body or in another body.

 
 
• **Example: ***A kidney was transplanted from one identical twin to another.*
